findings.detail: Accumulates the initial density and the next N−1 actual complete-channel iterates, then divides by N exactly. The extra final update computes rho_N without adding it to the mean.
Iterations apply the sum of all declared outcome branches. General residual operators are allowed in channel_operator, while iterate_state and cesaro_average validate a normalized density input.
Mean requires positive int N; bool, Fraction, float, zero, and negatives are rejected as appropriate. Existing exact PSD/density contract supports dimensions 1–4.

Tests compare with the explicit parity mean diag(ceil(N/2)/N,floor(N/2)/N), actual endpoint parity, telescope identity, and the sharp P0 residual for odd N. The oracle is not another call to the averaging algorithm.
Identity channel has two distinct fixed densities; Pauli-X trajectory alternates. These distinguish existence and average behavior from uniqueness or raw-orbit convergence.

all_effect_budget=1/N is labelled as an upper budget. A computed P0 residual is not treated as numerical maximization over all effects or as new empirical data. Lean/Python verification boundaries are explicit.

scope_not_reviewed_as_a_proof: general stationary existence by finite testing
